TC-12-6.note: Read by hand (2026-11-04). Reasons quote the profile ('Raised the accessibility score of the site from 71 to 96', 'Barista and shift supervisor, Corner Beans Cafe, 2018-2021') or say it is silent ('The profile is silent on a forklift licence'). No invented evidence was found in the 20 jobs read. Observation, not a defect: when only one criterion can be checked the overall is extreme (Barista 10/10, Registered Nurse 0/10 with 1 of 3 checked); the card says '1 of 3 criteria could be checked'. Also some postings carry a generic criterion such as a short cover letter. Both are prompt-tuning items for a later iteration.
